jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.


Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.


Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.


eBay is a global marketplace connecting millions of buyers and sellers across more than 190 markets. People come to eBay to discover unique and pre\-loved goods, pursue their interests, and grow businesses. Our purpose is to connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

  

  

**About the team and the role**


Low Cost Shipping is a key strategic initiative focused on delivering a more affordable, competitive, and sustainable shipping experience for eBay and Depop customers. By employing lower shipping costs to offer compelling customer pricing, the initiative aims to drive adoption, influence customer behavior, and unlock new growth opportunities, all while strengthening operational efficiency and long\-term unit economics.

  

  

This role leads the economic architecture of the low cost shipping business. You will own the business recommendation on pricing, subsidy, unit economics, contribution, and the economic conditions required to launch, expand, or change course.

  

  

The role sits at the intersection of customer behavior and physical network economics: understanding how cost changes with parcel flow and density, how buyers and sellers respond to price, and whether lower shipping prices create incremental marketplace activity rather than simply subsidizing existing transactions.

  

  

**What you will accomplish**


* Manage the end\-to\-end economic model for low cost shipping, including partner rates, network costs, buyer pricing, subsidy, contribution, and fixed and variable investment
* Understand economics at the level that decisions are actually made: by market, parcel flow, customer cohort, partner, and network stage rather than relying on blended averages
* Define buyer\-facing pricing and subsidy recommendations that balance adoption, incrementality, contribution economics, and the long\-term path to structurally lower shipping cost
* Establish the economic thresholds that determine when the business should STOP, SLOW, or EXPAND, including break\-even volume, density, utilization, and subsidy requirements
* Develop a deep understanding of price sensitivity, incrementality, cohort response, and experiment outcomes; continuously update the economic thesis as customer behavior becomes observable
* Distinguish incremental marketplace value from shipment substitution. Determine whether pricing changes are creating incremental conversion, frequency, GMV, or low\-ASP TAM rather than simply moving existing volume or buying adoption
* Build scenarios and sensitivities that show how partner rates, flow mix, density, node utilization, customer behavior, and network design change the economics and required investment
* Translate the analysis into clear business recommendations for senior leaders on pricing, investment, network expansion, partner economics, and market sequencing
  

  

**What you will bring**


* Deep quantitative fluency and the ability to personally work through complex financial, operational, customer, and network data rather than relying solely on prepared analysis. SQL or equivalent analytical capability is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of pricing, elasticity, experimentation, incrementality, unit economics, contribution economics, and sensitivity analysis
* Experience building economic models where customer behavior and cost structure interact — ideally in marketplaces, logistics, transportation, consumer pricing, or another network business
* Ability to distinguish correlation from causality and design or interpret experiments that can support pricing and investment decisions
* Strong commercial judgment: able to translate detailed analysis into a recommendation, identify the few assumptions that actually drive the answer, and state what evidence would change the recommendation
* Ability to challenge partner cost structures, operating assumptions, forecasts, and internally generated business cases rather than treating supplied inputs as fixed
* Demonstrated ability to influence Finance, Product, Analytics, Growth, Operations, and senior leadership without direct authority
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; advanced quantitative training is useful but not required
  

  

**How we will measure success**


Success means we can answer, with increasing confidence: what does each parcel flow actually cost, what customer price changes behavior, how much subsidy is required, how much demand is incremental, and at what volume and density the network becomes structurally advantaged.

  

  

The role succeeds when better economics allow us to sustainably lower customer shipping prices and unlock incremental marketplace activity — not simply when low cost shipping volume increases or the modeled P\&L improves.

**Customer Centricity – Always Spot the Customer**  

Everything we do is focused on helping our customers succeed. We lead with empathy, build trust through action, and create value for both external and internal customers.

**Teamwork – We Win Together**  

We operate with honesty, transparency, trust, and respect. We collaborate openly, take shared ownership of outcomes, and succeed as a team.

**About Bells of Steel Inc.**
-----------------------------


We’re a rapidly growing e\-commerce company that designs and sells strength equipment across Canada, the USA, the UK, Australia, and now Europe, starting with Germany. We compete with the biggest names in the industry by moving fast, listening to customers, and building products that punch above their weight.


Our purpose is to make strength training accessible to all, and have fun doing it. Our 10\-year target is 1 million customers made stronger, and over the next three years we’re growing to $50 million USD in annual revenue.


As we continue to grow, we're looking for a **Director of Marketing** to own how Bells of Steel reaches, wins, and keeps customers in every market we serve.


This is a strategic leadership role responsible for deciding **where we show up, what we say, and how every marketing dollar earns its place.**


You'll own our marketing strategy, brand positioning, channel and campaign calendar, paid media strategy, creative strategy and testing, and the marketing Scorecard. You'll work closely with our founder, e\-commerce, product, sales, customer service, finance, and our international teams to turn great products into growth.


You'll lead a marketing team of about 16 people across marketing operations, retention, affiliates and partnerships, social and community, creative and video, and paid search and paid social. You don't need to do it all yourself, but you need to be strong enough in each area to coach your channel owners and hold them to a high standard.


This is an **AI\-first role**. Over your first year, you'll lead an AI transformation across marketing: upgrading and replacing manual workflows with AI, and working with our in\-house developers to build our own tools that outperform the paid software we use today.


If you're someone who reads a Scorecard like a story, moves budget toward what works and away from what doesn't, and can build a brand that real lifters trust, we'd love to meet you.


This is a hybrid role based in Calgary, with about half your time in the office and half working from home. Your office days are where the best marketing happens: in the photo studio for a shoot, on the showroom floor talking to customers, walking over to the product team to plan a launch, and lifting on the equipment you're selling.


Relocation support is available for the right candidate.

* Grow our reach with former lifters, practical beginners, parents, and professionals without losing the core lifters who built the brand.
* Make sure our customer journey, from discovery to setup to training, and our 30\-day money back guarantee show up consistently in every customer touchpoint.
